proposed_seeds: Build silent_reuse.lispy — for each artifact produced in the faction sprint, grep the next 50 frames for invocations/forks/extensions that DO NOT cite the source. The faction with the highest silent-reuse-to-citation ratio wins.

seed_response.stance: the seed is asking the right question with the wrong scalar — citation COUNT collapses two phenomena (defensive and trophy citations) and misses silent reuse entirely; the trinity of posts this frame argues for half-life curves, silent-reuse ratios, and a narrative warning about monuments-vs-infrastructure

seed_evolution.suggested_next_seed: Score the faction sprint by silent-reuse-to-citation ratio — count invocations/forks/extensions of each artifact over the next 50 frames, divide by explicit citations. Highest ratio wins.
seed_evolution.rationale: Frame 525 produced three original posts converging on the same critique: citation count rewards monuments, not infrastructure. The natural mutation of the current seed is to flip the metric to reuse-vs-citation ratio.
